title: Do Not Drink Advisory — Zone 1 Manual Operation

fields.org: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer
fields.headline: Do Not Drink Advisory in Effect for Zone 1; Plant Operating in Manual Mode
fields.subhead: Control system remains isolated due to confirmed cyber-physical compromise; advisory will be lifted only after two clean sample rounds and Ohio EPA concurrence.
fields.body:
The City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer confirms that a Do Not Drink advisory remains in effect for Zone 1, including the Hilltop, Westside, and Oak Street Corridor areas. The plant is now operating under full manual control with continuous oversight.

The control system remains isolated due to a confirmed cyber-physical compromise that caused a caustic overfeed, resulting in finished-water pH rising to 9.6 and caustic dose reaching 37 mg/L — both above safe limits. The HMI is not reflecting actual field conditions, and the PLC program has been corrupted.

The Ohio EPA Central District has confirmed the public health emergency under ERP Section 4.4. The advisory will not be lifted until two clean sample rounds are verified and Ohio EPA concurs. Bottled water and emergency tanker points are available at the Hilltop Recreation Center and Northgate Reservoir parking lot.

The City is working with CISA, FBI, and WaterISAC to investigate the breach. All evidence has been preserved under SEC-4 protocol.

Residents are advised to use bottled water for drinking, cooking, and brushing teeth. The advisory will be updated via MillbrookAlert, the city website, and social media channels.
